issues.title: Persistent Planning Channel layout/status
issues.body:
It would be great if we could make these aspects of the PlanningChannel persistent between browser reloads (via storing as cookies, like we do for page layout):
* [x] Current tab
* [x] Current width of support panel
* For tables:
    * [x] Currently visible columns
    * [x] Whether filters are shown
    * [x] Which filters are applied
    * [x] Sort on any columns
    * [x] Number of rows visible
    * [x] Current turn number (_think_ this is stored in `ChannelPlanning` - so it would probably be stored/retrieved from there)

Note: I'd like the key to start with `serge.planning` and be suffixed with the current role-id (`selectedRoleId` - passed down from `SupportPanel` if necessary)

comments.body:
Re-opening, it would be useful to remember the number of rows visible too, please.

Aah, and to include the role-name in the keys for filters.  We _may_ get an instance where the player switches to another role, and we try to restore filter settings that don't work for the new role - including trying to display a tab that the current user doesn't see (only umpires see the adjudication tab)
Aah, @lebaphi  - I think we still need to include the role-id in the filters, please, as described above.

Hi @IanMayo , about this item:
> Number of rows visible

Can you explain more about this scenario? when do we need to use it?

Hello @lebaphi - at the bottom of the material table, the players can use the drop-down to choose how many rows to view.  It would be useful if the value of this was persistent.
